content.rendered:
Kindergarten Registration Packets are now available in the front office. Please stop in the office to pick up a packet between 9:15 am – 3:30 pm.

2018-19 Kindergarten Roundup:  All elementary schools will be hosting a Kindergarten Roundup on March 7 from 3:30-6:00 p.m. Meet the teachers, turn in registration packets, and learn how to prepare for transition to elementary school.  See the flyer here!
